title: Mallok T-012 accepted release evidence v1

x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.candidateBinding: candidateSha must equal the clean checked-out Git commit and the filename segment `.mallok/evidence/T-012/${candidateSha}.json`.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.canonicalOrdering: gateResults are unique and sorted by name, artifactHashes are unique and sorted by path, and both origin arrays are unique and sorted by Unicode code-unit order.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.artifactCoverage: artifactHashes must cover every release tarball plus the exact Cloudflare candidate build manifest, embedded asset manifest and Worker bundle accepted for this candidate. Every path is project-relative, no-follow, resolves within the project, is a regular file and must match its SHA-256 immediately before evidence finalization.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.immutableEvidence: The file is owner-only, written by exclusive create or temp+fsync+rename when absent, and may never replace different bytes at the same candidate path. It must not contain its own exact-bytes digest.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.reviewAuthority: reviewedBy records the authenticated human reviewer identity supplied at finalization. Automation cannot infer acceptance or synthesize a reviewer.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.secretBoundary: Evidence must not contain credentials, full cloud resource identifiers, content bodies, raw logs or secret-match values.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.canonicalOrigins: For every networkOrigins/cloudflareApiOrigins item, new URL(value).origin must equal value exactly. Scheme and host are lowercase, userinfo/path/query/fragment are absent, default port 443 is omitted, and any explicit decimal port is in 1..65535. The regex rejects userinfo/path and zero; runtime performs URL parsing, default-port and upper-bound checks.
